nom: Tower 28 SOS Daily Rescue Soothing Hypochlorous Acid Spray for Face (1 oz)

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are mostly positive, reporting calmer, less reactive skin with regular use, though one reviewer with sensitive, redness-prone skin developed a blotchy, itchy rash after a few uses.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including several with eczema, mostly report it hydrates and calms their skin without stinging, though one reviewer found the hydration wore off quickly and left her skin feeling drier than before.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with eczema or dry skin, describe the spray as hydrating and non-drying even with daily use; a couple of reviewers, however, report it stung and left their skin feeling dry, or that the initial hydration evaporated quickly.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers, including some with rosacea or anxiety-related redness, report a visible reduction in redness, in some cases within about 30 minutes; a couple of reviewers, though, say it triggered a rash or made little difference to their redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers generally describe the spray as calming and supportive for a compromised or reactive skin barrier, including easing burning from a harsh vitamin C reaction and soothing eczema and perioral dermatitis, though one reviewer with sensitive, redness-prone skin reacted with irritation instead.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who use it for acne or breakouts, including hormonal and workout-related breakouts, report clearer skin and fewer new blemishes within days to a couple of weeks; one reviewer, however, developed small breakouts after using it as a substitute for washing her face in the morning.

aspects.libelle: Bottle arrives without safety seal or looks used
Warehouse sticker damages bottle, hard to remove
Expensive for the amount of product
Convenient travel size for gym bag or purse

extraits.texte: I was really excited to try this for my very sensitive, dry skin that’s prone to redness. Thankfully I bought the travel size to try out, because this is not a good product for my skin. I’ve only used it a few times and each time my skin gets a blotchy rash and my skin becomes super itchy and irritated. I agree with other reviewers that it smells slightly like bleach or chlorine, which is concerning. Sending back.

The scent reminded me of a public bath, which I didn’t like. However, the mist sprayed evenly and generously, so I was satisfied with the spray power. It felt hydrating when I first applied it, but after a short time, it seemed like the moisture evaporated quickly from my skin, leaving it feeling even drier. I was hoping it would help reduce redness, but I didn’t notice much difference. I don’t think I’ll repurchase it.

I went in for a facial and they recommended this product as an alternative for face washing in the morning. They also recommended I use before and during hot yoga. I like using it during yoga but not as an alternative to face washing. It’s been almost 2 weeks now and my face has small breakouts now from using this product instead of washing in the mornings. As all the other reviews warned, the Amazon label is directly on the bottle and very hard to get off. Cheapens the product. Next time I will try another brand that had just as good reviews for $13 less.

I was looking for a product that I could add to my skin care to help with redness and came across this gold mine. I suffer from pretty bad anxiety, which I found out affects my skin barrier making it super red. My skin in general is extremely sensitive, which is why I’ve stuck with the same products since my teens, so whenever I introduce something new, I can get a little hesitant. This stuff works so fast and will forever be part of my skincare routine. Within 30 minutes there is a visible reduction in redness. I’m also a makeup girly so being able to even out my skin tone as much as possible before I apply my make up ensures that I’m blending my concealers/ foundations to match my true skin tone, instead of that anxious red tone. As for the rating, I give it a 4/5 ⭐️ because it doesn’t give a tremendous change, but definitely a noticeable one. I’m sure there are other products out there that could practically erase redness, but due to my skins sensitivity, this makes for a perfect fit without worrying about any reactive breakouts. Overall, I would totally recommend this to anyone with the same concerns. *** FIRST PIC IS WITH PRODUCT. SECOND PIC IS BEFORE PRODUCT***

First off, I received this as a "birthday gift" for being a member of Sephora. I wanted to come on here to leave an unbiased review. I am a stay at home mom of teenage boys, a gardener and homemaker who rarely wears a full face of makeup. I am familiar with Tower 28 products and currently use their tinted moisturizer that my son matched for me a couple of years ago. He did such a great job and that product has stuck with me ever since. I decided to grab this freebie as my birthday gift from Sephora because Tower 28 has left an impression on me. I immediately doused my face with this spray the moment I got in the car after leaving the store. I had nothing on my face and it left me feeling refreshed and hydrated. I have eczema and dry skin, especially during the winter. I live in NW Ohio, so our winters are a bit bipolar, but our house is super dry during the winter months. I will definitely be buying a full size of this SOS Daily Rescue Facial Spray for very regular use!
If i could gove 20 stars i will, best product for my rosacea is the only thing that works for me not even a prescribed medication do this!

I struggle with eczema and dry skin, especially in the colder months and with living in a desert. I was skeptical that something just water based could help my skin, vs thick creams and lotions, but I really feel the difference. I especially like to use it right after I dry off after a shower, and on my hands throughout the day when I wash them , and on my face right after washing. I took a pic of both bottles next to a pair of scissors for scale. I really like having a little bottle I can take with me on the go.
